overview: Compare the original personal plan with recorded hours for the whole team, then explore work types. Saved reports keep their original week and people.
quickStart: Calculate a team report with the saved project baseline. Advanced options let you choose a different saved scope.
workTypeHelp: Use one Work type category per recorded entry. Other tags are labels; uncategorized time remains in the total.
reviewHint: Each person’s original weekly plan is reviewed only when all non-archived tasks in the work package were done at calculation. This is not a shared package-budget accuracy metric.
zeroPlanRatio: Ratio unavailable for a zero plan
noPackageBaseline: Work type is a single category per recorded entry; other task tags may overlap.
